the_full_game.title: No, you are not allowed to summon demons inside of the museum.
the_full_game.description:
Heyo. This is a book that likely would have had relics if i was better at managing my time lol. Idk. Maybe if theres enough interest on this game, I would definently be down to continuing this project (rather than working than my pre-existing junk lol). So let me know if you like this game! :D
		This book would have had relics themed around the occult. Like vintage tarot cards, a real ceremonial dagger, and a crystal ball.
